summary: A value with runtime-checked shared and mutable borrows.

types.name: struct rcell<T>
types.description: A struct that stores a value and tracks its active borrow state.

functions.name: new
functions.description: Creates a borrow cell containing a value.

functions.name: borrow_const
functions.signature: comptime expr void rcell::borrow_const<T>(expr rcell<T>& cell, expr(const T&) void proc)
functions.description: Runs a callback with a shared borrow of the cell value.

parameters.name: proc
parameters.description: The callback receiving the shared borrow.

functions.name: borrow
functions.signature: comptime expr void rcell::borrow<T>(expr rcell<T>& cell, expr(T&) void proc)
functions.description: Runs a callback with an exclusive mutable borrow of the cell value.

parameters.name: proc
parameters.description: The callback receiving the mutable borrow.

functions.name: release
functions.description: Clears the mutable-borrow state of a cell.

parameters.name: cell
parameters.description: The cell whose state is released.

functions.name: release_const
functions.description: Decrements the shared-borrow state of a cell.

parameters.name: cell
parameters.description: The cell whose shared borrow is released.
